Sonia Gandhi criticizes Modi govt's silence on Gaza; BJP alleges double standards

Sonia Gandhi has criticized the Modi government for its silence regarding the situation in Gaza, accusing it of a 'stony silence' and a policy that harms India's interests. She called for India to advocate for Palestinian rights and respond to global sentiment. The BJP responded by accusing the Congress of double standards on the issue.
